main_claim: Arman Tsarukyan, ahead of his UFC 331 fight with Mauricio Ruffy, says he will become lightweight champion and beat Makhachev's record of four title defences.
note: Topuria appears only in the headline ('convencido de que superará a Ilia Topuria en el peso ligero'); the body never names him and is Tsarukyan talking about his own title ambitions and Ruffy. Centrality unsure between only_mentioned (the headline is the article's own text) and not_in_content (nothing in the body); act is none_of_these because Tsarukyan speaks about himself and makes no statement about Topuria.

main_claim: Song Yadong says he does not hold Usman Nurmagomedov's apparent elbow motion after the Umar Nurmagomedov knockout against him.
note: Topuria's name occurs only in an inserted 'LATEST NEWS: Arman Tsarukyan: Why the UFC won't make Ilia Topuria vs. Paddy Pimblett next' link, which is page furniture; the article is Song Yadong's quotes to BiliBili about Usman. Act is none_of_these because nobody in the article does anything regarding Topuria.

main_claim: After his decision win over Soriano at UFC Fight Night 287, Donchenko says he wants Daniel Rodriguez next, ideally at the year's last event or as an APEX five-rounder.
note: 'Please, let me fight just with him' is a wish for an opponent, so the fact is no_fact and next fight is no; the win over Soriano is retold around a post-fight interview ('He won almost every round on every card'), which the guide treats as background, but the account is detailed enough that an editor could call the fact result and reports_his_result yes.

main_claim: Joe Rogan warns that Topuria must be careful not to come back too soon after the damage he took against Gaethje.
note: Rogan ('UFC color commentator') says 'You gotta be very careful how you recover... A lot of great fighters have made the mistake of coming back too soon', sincere advice, so steers_him, though 'Ilia's a very mentally strong guy' could read as assesses_him. The writer's 'Topuria hinted that he was ready to make a comeback' is a hint, not a stated fact, so no_fact rather than status_update; Topuria's Instagram words ('after visiting that hell, I am stronger than before') are quoted, so he_speaks is yes.

main_claim: The writer's weekly UFC power rankings after Fight Night 286, with Makhachev first and Topuria dropped to fifth after his loss to Gaethje.
note: Topuria is one entry in a ten-man ranking ('has slipped to fifth on this list after losing badly to Justin Gaethje'); the loss is background and the X-status detail is trivia, so no_fact. The writer does rate him ('his god-like complex got in the way'), hence assesses_him, but an editor could say nobody does anything regarding him and pick none_of_these.

main_claim: Usman Nurmagomedov's manager Ali Abdelaziz says Usman would make Topuria tap out, and Topuria's manager Malki Kawa fires back that Topuria would annihilate his roster and beat Gaethje in a rematch.
note: The piece is split between Usman's possible UFC move (Abdelaziz: 'I want his first fight in the UFC to be against Ilia Topuria... Usman would make Ilia tap out') and the reply of 'his manager Malki Kawa' ('Shut your mouth. Ilia Topuria would 100% annihilate your roster'), so I take the Topuria-side news as Kawa answering for him; an editor could instead pick source other_fighter_side with act calls_him_out, or call Topuria main_subject. Everything said is trash talk or a wish ('When the rematch comes, you'll see'), and the options listed are not talks, so no_fact.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight though nothing is scheduled, and that either a Gaethje rematch or a Pimblett fight would suit the UFC.
note: 'We don't have him on the schedule right now, but listen, Topuria's ready to fight. We're ready for him' is the promotion stating where he stands, with Gaethje and Pimblett named only as options ('we don't have anything set'), so status_update and next fight no; 'Recovery has gone well' is the writer's line, so health no.

main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili says his friend Topuria is well and very positive, enjoying life and resting to come back stronger.
note: Merab, named as his friend and not linked to a fight with him, tells Helen Yee 'Topuria está bien y tiene una actitud muy positiva... Es muy fuerte, tanto física como mentalmente', a named person saying how he is, which the guide files as health; but he names no injury (the nose and orbital fractures are the writer's recap), so an editor could call it status_update with health no. Next fight is no: Gaethje, Tsarukyan, Pimblett and Usman are listed only as unknowns.

main_claim: Donchenko recounts his path: a Korosten childhood after his father's death, judo at 11, a year of philology at KPI, then quitting university to train in Thailand.
note: He speaks at length about family, hometown and schooling ('коли мені було шість років... помер тато', 'рік провчився в КПІ на філолога'), so the fact is personal_life stated by himself. The June win over Berggren and the 5 September bout with Soriano are the writer's closing recap, so result and next fight are no.

main_claim: Donchenko explains he wants Daniel Rodriguez next because he is ranked 15th and is the most convenient top-15 opponent for him.
note: 'Я обрав Родрігеса, тому що він 15-й номер рейтингу' is his wish for an opponent with no talks reported, so no_fact and next fight no; the Soriano, Berggren and Morono wins are recapped as background to a post-fight comment, so result is no.

main_claim: Donchenko faces Punahele Soriano on the UFC Fight Night 287 main card in Paris, around 23:00 Kyiv time, with the broadcast on Setanta Sports+.
note: A watch-online page for his bout covering both fighters, card order and start times ('основний кард заплановано на 22:00. Донченко та Соріано вийдуть в октагон орієнтовно о 23:00'), so fight_week_event with nobody speaking; the booking is the premise of the page, so next fight is no, though an editor could count a same-day bout announcement as next_fight. The stray line 'Українець завоював четверту звитягу поспіль' sits among the related-links furniture after the error notice, so I do not count it as a result, with some doubt.

main_claim: Punahele Soriano, before meeting Donchenko at UFC Paris, says being underestimated has helped him and calls Donchenko a scary, wild young fighter.
note: Soriano 'meets Daniil Donchenko on September 5 at Accor Arena', so he is opponent side, and '100 percent, man; scary dude, wild dude... he's young and has that young man's fire' assesses him. The booking is the premise of a pre-fight interview, so no_fact and next fight no per the guide, though a preview of a set fight could be read as next_fight.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje says the UFC has the final say on a rematch with Topuria, which he does not feel should be his next fight, and that he will not fight again until 2027.
note: Gaethje, who beat him in June, speaks about his own next fight ('no siento que esa deba ser mi siguiente pelea') and guesses Topuria will not fight until next year 'para recuperarse de algunas lesiones', neither a plain statement about him, hence none_of_these; the paraphrase that Topuria 'no hizo méritos suficientes' could support assesses_him. The rematch is only a possibility with no talks, and the fractures are the writer's recap, so no_fact and health no.

main_claim: The writer previews and picks five UFC Paris main-card fights, favouring Soriano over Donchenko because Donchenko's takedown defence is unproven.
note: Donchenko gets one of five fight breakdowns with a pick against him ('I'm just not sure Donchenko has the tight, powerful boxing necessary to stand his ground'), a preview of his fight covering both men, though in a ten-fighter roundup an editor could call it only_mentioned. The booking is the premise, so no_fact and next fight no.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje says his knockout loss to Max Holloway was a building block for his run to the lightweight title and that he has no retirement date in mind.
note: Topuria appears only as the opponent Gaethje already beat ('this win over Topuria wouldn't have been as special'), background in Gaethje's own story about Holloway and retirement, so Gaethje is opponent side and act is none_of_these because he speaks about himself and makes no statement about Topuria.
